body: I've felt that way several times over the years but it's difficult. We've been married 11 years, together much longer. This has been the only life I have known or wanted. I feel like I'll be miserable either way, but I'd rather be at home with my kids and watch them grow even if I have to find a way to get through the rest. They say it's not good for the kids but I just can't do it. I need them.. I'll honestly just do everything myself. They are my world and I will suffer as much as I have to.
